 Aaron Nesmith (hamstring) ruled out for Wednesday 
 by Leo Sells | Pacers Correspondent | Tue, Oct 20th 2026, 8:30pm EDT 
 Aaron Nesmith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the New Orleans Pelicans. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Nesmith won't be able to play on Wednesday. He's dealing with a hamstring injury right now, and his next chance to play will come on Friday against the Mavericks. Expect Kelly Oubre Jr. and possibly Obi Toppin to see more work in his absence.
